test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Read the sentence below and choose the meaning of the idiom that best fits the context:

"Mr. Smith: There's a little time before lunch. I think I'm going to lie down for a while and catch forty winks."

What does the idiom "catch forty winks" mean in this context?
solution:
The correct answer is: **2 i.e. Take a short nap**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"catch forty winks"** means to take a short nap or a brief period of sleep during the day. (थोड़ा सोना)
 
 
• **Example:** After working hard all morning, he decided to catch forty winks before heading back to work.
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, Mr. Smith mentions lying down for a while, which aligns with the meaning of "catch forty winks." (थोड़ा आराम करके सोना)
 
 
• **Example:** She often catches forty winks during her lunch break to recharge for the afternoon.
